message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on the fact: The defendant fabricated counterfeit currency samples and provided them to someone who wanted to make counterfeit money. This is "伪造货币" i.e., counterfeit currency. The label in examples: For counterfeit money they used "信用卡诈骗" for credit card fraud, "滥伐林木" for illegal logging, etc. For counterfeit currency, we need to see if any example includes similar. There is example: "出售、购买、运输假币" for selling, buying, transporting counterfeit money. Also "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章" for forging official documents. For counterfeit currency, likely "伪造货币" or "伪造人民币". The Chinese criminal law article: "伪造货币罪". So answer: [罪名]伪造货币<eoa>. Possibly also "提供假币材料" but main is counterfeit money. So single crime.
